equity.level_reason: Racial and ethnic disparities are named, but the article gives only shares of cases and deaths by race (composition), with no group-specific outcome or computed contrast; race/ethnicity is a descriptor.

level_alternative.reason: The 87% share of deaths in Black persons set beside their 33% share of cases could be read as a side-by-side group comparison framed as a disparity.

ev.q: Health disparities were observed among racial and ethnic minority groups, including Black (33%) and Hispanic persons (31%).

equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity shares of cases are given without population denominators; race missing for 1,638 cases. Vaccine equity projects are described as mitigating disparities, but no measure is reported.

notes: A response overview. VE estimates, the 9.6-fold incidence ratio and the MSM behavior survey are cited from earlier reports (refs 8, 9, 11), not computed here. The prepass diagnostic_accuracy cue is a false hit ('cultural sensitivity'). Design inferred: no design is named.
view_issues: The Summary says 87% of 42 fatal cases occurred in Black persons, but the text gives 33 of 38 deaths through March 7, 2023. Dose counts vary: >1 million (Summary) vs >1.2 million (text).
